_comment: Section inventory for the fill engine (FILL-ENGINE-SPEC.md) and SECTION-REGISTER.md. Every anchor (class + exact text) verified programmatically against the live index.html DOM - see engine/README.md. order is canonical document order (owner decision 4: manifest can never reorder). starts: 'page'|'column'|null matches .starts-page/.starts-column (v24, source-derived StartParagraph law). disciplines: [] = always-kept regardless of discipline selection; non-empty = membership fully determined by discipline selection (see optionality note). toc: null = no ToC row, else {indent:bool}. parent: section id this is nested under, or null for a page-level or phase-level section. level: 'page'|'phase'|'sub' - 'phase' added 2026-08-09 sign-off, a genuine third tier between page and sub (stage-design-phase, stage-post-contract), ranking effectively equal to h2 in hierarchy weight. optionality: 'core'|'optional'|'rare' - core=always present when its disciplines (if any) are in scope; optional=commonly included/excluded per project independent of discipline; rare=narrow/uncommon commercial or scope arrangement. proposed: ALL FALSE as of the 2026-08-09 owner sign-off (ID FREEZE) - previously true marked a row where the id/level/parent required a judgment call; every such row is now resolved and frozen, no renames without a new owner sign-off. deviation_register_row: cross-reference to proposals/26-97109/DEVIATION-REGISTER.md's 16 rows (null if that register's scope never covered this section - it explicitly excluded 'purely structural/cosmetic' stories).
